answer: Random mutual audit blocks bulk fakes. Each identity posts a $20 bond and a sample: a saffron manifest. Three peers recheck it in 48 hours against port records at the jetty. A copied sample slashes the bond, freezes the identity, and slashes the referrer. It also covers a sonnet translation, checked against its source. Forging 1,000 costs $20,000 plus 3,000 checks, versus $3,000 rewards. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps undiluted rewards.
